objective: Fastest responses while retaining high throughput at high concurrency, quality, and reliability

treatments.meaningful_change: Move the 13.41 GiB per-rank PLE table into host memory, reserving its memory by capping previously unused KV capacity
Raise active sequence capacity from 8 to 16 with identical memory placement
Adaptive MTP count by active batch size: 6 at one sequence, 4 at two to four, 2 at five to eight, zero at nine to sixteen. Compare only after fixed-MTP seq16 treatment.
Only active sequence limit changes from baseline. Isolate confirmed long-context formatting regression from shared-memory/manual-KV treatment.

treatments.kv_dtype: auto, resolves to bfloat16 model dtype
treatments.meaningful_change: Only KV precision changes relative to disk-seq16; test whether removing FP8 KV rounding preserves the strict-format floor at 16 slots. Verify >=8 full-context capacity from live startup.

performance.cache: unique wave prefixes; equal prompt bytes across treatments
performance.contaminated_waves: retain evidence but exclude from score

promotion_gates.single_stream_latency: No material regression: median decode >=95% baseline and median TTFT <=110% baseline
promotion_gates.concurrent_throughput: C8/C16 aggregate throughput >=95% baseline; seek >=10% improvement
promotion_gates.concurrent_latency: C16 TTFT and E2E must improve; inspect all samples and fixture differences
promotion_gates.quality: No baseline-passing deterministic, tool, code, OCR, or retrieval checks may regress
promotion_gates.memory: Both ranks healthy, no OOM, no unexpected restart, no benchmark preemption; at least 8 GiB host MemAvailable after warmup; KV supports >=8 full 262K contexts
promotion_gates.route: Canonical model name, 262K context, existing API routes and ordinary client inference pass after final selection

limits: This is a controlled small-sample serving comparison, not a general model capability or production SLO benchmark.
Weights are kept fixed during serving optimization; a new quantized weight artifact requires a separately justified hypothesis and quality comparison.
Keep the baseline containers, launch configuration, and caches available for rollback.

startup_guard_correction.reason: Persisted 13.41 GiB shared PLE table reduces cudaMemGetInfo startup free memory. The old 0.8 guard rejected a warm launch even with manual KV size. Lower guard does not resize explicit KV allocation.
startup_guard_correction.qualification: Startup failure is unscored for performance; failed containers and logs retained.

repeat_control.reason: The case varies within one running treatment. Compare the original configuration again before assigning causality.
repeat_control.decision: Preserve all initial failures. Do not declare a quality regression resolved solely from a favorable rerun.

long_prefill_comparison.expected_size: approximately 8K input tokens; actual API token counts retained per stream
long_prefill_comparison.treatments: Baseline A/B/A control and selected candidate
long_prefill_comparison.gates: Compare TTFT, per-stream E2E and aggregate throughput under long prefills; inspect material regressions before promotion
long_prefill_comparison.fixture: Fixed synthetic record document, unique stream prefix prevents shared-prefix reuse across requests

shared_memory_decision.structured_json: passes both; preserve the raw-format failure as a regression

disk_seq16_decision.reason: Same strict near-context formatting regression: 0/10 versus baseline 10/10; semantics and JSON-schema control pass
